OUR MANUFACTURING PROCESS

FROM CONCEPT TO PRODUCTION.

A structured production workflow designed to turn your product requirements into finished sportswear for international B2B orders.

PHASE 01Stages 01 — 02

Discovery & Sampling

CONSULTATION & TECH PACK

Detailed specification alignment, CAD review, and pre-production sample creation for fit and approval.

PHASE 02Stages 03 — 04

Trims & Preparation

FABRIC & MATERIAL SOURCING

Technical fabric testing, custom dye lots, performance trim matching, and production line preparation.

PHASE 03Stages 05 — 08

Cutting, Sewing & QC

PRODUCTION & QUALITY CONTROL

Precision fabric cutting, skilled assembly stitching, branding application, and multi-stage inline inspection.

PHASE 04Stages 09 — 10

Finishing & Export

PACKING & GLOBAL SHIPPING

Individual polybag packaging, carton tagging, and worldwide export handover to trusted logistics carriers.
